# hyperfluid_compute_dock (Resource)

A Compute Dock: a Slurm cluster in an environment. Needs the organization's `compute_docks_enabled` feature.

~> Removing a partition leaves its nodes running until the platform prunes them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_environment" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

resource "hyperfluid_compute_dock" "hpc" {
  env       = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
  name      = "hpc"
  home_size = "100Gi"

  partitions = [
    {
      name     = "cpu"
      cpu      = "8"
      memory   = "32Gi"
      node_max = 4
      default  = true
    },
    {
      name         = "gpu"
      cpu          = "16"
      memory       = "64Gi"
      gpu          = 1
      node_max     = 2
      walltime_max = "24:00:00"
    },
  ]

  auto_suspend_idle_minutes = 60
}

output "ssh_endpoint" {
  value = hyperfluid_compute_dock.hpc.ssh_endpoint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `env` (String) Environment id. Changing this forces a new dock.
- `name` (String) Name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Changing this forces a new dock.
- `partitions` (Attributes List) Compute partitions, at least one, replaced as a whole. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--partitions))

### Optional

- `accounting_enabled` (Boolean) Whether `sacct` job accounting runs. Changing this forces a new dock.
- `auto_suspend_idle_minutes` (Number) Idle minutes after which the cluster suspends; omitted, it never suspends on its own.
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) `false` suspends the cluster; its compute scales to zero.
- `engine` (String) Compute engine: `slurm`. Changing this forces a new dock.
- `home_size` (String) Size of the shared `/home` volume, e.g. `"100Gi"`.
- `home_storage_class` (String) `ReadWriteMany` storage class of `/home`. Changing this forces a new dock.
- `login_enabled` (Boolean) Whether an SSH login node runs. Changing this forces a new dock.
- `login_replicas` (Number) Number of login replicas. Changing this forces a new dock.
- `oci_jobs` (Boolean) Let jobs run in their own OCI image; not recovered by import. Changing this forces a new dock.
- `rest_api_enabled` (Boolean) Whether `slurmrestd` runs. Changing this forces a new dock.
- `rest_api_replicas` (Number) Number of `slurmrestd` replicas. Changing this forces a new dock.
- `tags` (List of String) User-defined tags.
- `version` (String) Slurm image tag; omitted, the platform default is used, and removing it keeps the current tag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase, e.g. `Running` or `Suspended`.
- `rest_endpoint` (String) `slurmrestd` endpoint.
- `slug` (String) Derived slug.
- `ssh_endpoint` (String) SSH endpoint of the login node.

<a id="nestedatt--partitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `partitions`

Required:

- `cpu` (String) CPU per node, e.g. `"8"`.
- `memory` (String) Memory per node, e.g. `"32Gi"`.
- `name` (String) Partition name, unique within the dock.
- `node_max` (Number) Maximum number of nodes.

Optional:

- `default` (Boolean) Whether jobs land here when they name no partition.
- `gpu` (Number) GPUs per node.
- `node_min` (Number) Nodes kept running; `0` scales to zero.
- `walltime_max` (String) Maximum job duration, e.g. `"04:00:00"`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Compute Dock import id is the dock id (uuid).
terraform import hyperfluid_compute_dock.hpc 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
